messages.subject: Data entry
parts:
Is there a specific format that the X Y trap coordinates need to be in when creating a trapfile?
E.G. UTM vs Decimal degrees? Mine are in UTM since that is what ARC GIS uses.
Thanks for the info.

Lauren

messages.author: b1d2e118c1689e57
messages.subject: Re: Data entry
parts:
The format used will become the units of distance inference, and hence it overwhelmingly makes sense to use Northing and Easting in metres (and Mercator distortion is unlikely to be an issue at most study scales).

Any GIS software will be able to convert easily among them, but there are also online converters e.g. LINZ.

James
